plugins.name: immutable
plugins.description: Append-only SDD toolkit covering the full 7-step flow from problem framing through PR creation. Skills: /immutable:init (starter bootstrap), /immutable:office-hours (premise + alternatives), /immutable:prd (pitch authoring — WHAT), /immutable:design (app-side context), /immutable:plan-review-ceo (scope challenge + adversarial review), /immutable:plan-review-eng (engineering review + worktree analysis), /immutable:adr (Architecture Decision Records — WHY), /immutable:ship (PR creation), /immutable:migrate (one-shot config + profile schema migration). Authoring skills enforce a grill-me interview, multi-persona adversarial review, and a 90% completeness gate. Ships a PostToolUse read gate (the plugin's first hook) that withholds the body of a deprecated doc at Read time, so a dead spec cannot be mistaken for current requirements. The flow runs standalone — no external harness required. Built from two layered fusions: the immutable-prd lineage (append-only artifacts with supersede chains for accuracy + accountability) and the gstack lineage (transient → artifact flow pipeline). See plugin README's Design heritage for the full origin story. In a repo that opts in, /immutable:prd also authors against a tracker ticket's binding sections (the requirement contract): it records the ticket's identity and version coordinate instead of quoting it, judges every item, and turns an open correction request into a validator-enforced merge gate; scripts/requirement_contract.py reads tickets through pluggable adapters and reports drift.
